note: Hand-curated, sourced entries. Utah redistricted before 2026, so every sitting member is running in a renumbered district.

UT-house-1.statusNote: Open seat under Utah's new map: former Rep. Ben McAdams (D) won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Riley Owen, Libertarian Jesse West and unaffiliated candidate Elias Montgomery.

UT-house-2.statusNote: Rep. Blake Moore (R), who represented the old 1st district, faces Democrat Peter Crosby, Independent American candidate Carlton Bowen, Libertarian Daniel Cottam and unaffiliated candidate Robert Moesinger after the June 23, 2026 primary.

sources.label: The Green Papers: Utah 2026 general election candidates

UT-house-3.statusNote: Rep. Celeste Maloy (R), who represented the old 2nd district, faces Democrat Kent Udell, Constitution Party candidate Cassie Easley, Libertarian Mike Stoddard and unaffiliated candidates Adonis Hooslyn and Ayden Scott after the June 23, 2026 primary.

sources.label: The Green Papers: Utah 2026 general election candidates

UT-house-4.statusNote: Rep. Mike Kennedy (R), who represented the old 3rd district, is the incumbent running under Utah's new map. He faces Democrat Jonny Larsen, Libertarian Taylor Wright and unaffiliated candidate Steven Burt after the June 23, 2026 primary.

candidates.name: Elias Henry Montgomery
candidates.background: Unaffiliated candidate running a detailed policy platform for Utah's 1st Congressional District, blending deregulation, anti-monopoly, and government-reform proposals.
priorities: Phasing out the federal income tax

cost.label: Would lower costs by "breaking down artificial market barriers to bring relief to housing and essential goods" (Montgomery campaign)

health.label: Mixed: proposes a "catastrophic healthcare floor to shield every family from medical bankruptcy" combined with "competitive private options" (Montgomery campaign)

housing.label: Would "discourage large-scale institutional purchase of single-family homes and prioritize owner-occupants" (Montgomery campaign)

immigration.label: Mixed: would "streamline the legal queue" for immigration while keeping ICE "focus[ed] on violent threats" and securing borders (Montgomery campaign)

taxes.label: Would "end federal income taxation on individual citizens over a locked 10-year horizon," shifting collection to states (Montgomery campaign)

climate.label: Would "enforce direct environmental liability" so polluters "pay directly for ecological waste footprints" while cutting red tape for local clean energy (Montgomery campaign)

safety.label: Mixed: would fund "professional police" while requiring "uniform body-camera operation" and "independent citizen oversight boards" (Montgomery campaign)

repro.label: Would "shift away from weaponized criminal systems and invest heavily in vulnerable families" while protecting medical exceptions (Montgomery campaign)

democracy.label: Would "end gerrymandering with independent maps" and "prevent party monopolies" through proportional nomination rules (Montgomery campaign)

nullNotes.education: Platform addresses school library book-curation criteria, a curriculum-control dispute that does not map to the public-funding-vs-choice axis defined here (checked Aug 29, 2026)
